title: Transformers as Generic Deep Neural Networks: Exact Compilation, the Cost of Removing Activation-Activation Products, and Multi-Agent Attention Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2610.28958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers are deployed as a special model class. Neural processing units (NPU) add dedicated operators for attention and normalization, and quantization relies on Transformer-specific algorithms. We show the computation does not force this. Every Transformer block, with attention, LayerNorm and a GELU MLP, compiles exactly into a generic deep neural network built from fixed affine maps, routing and the square, sigmoid and inverse square root, plus GELU or its sigmoid approximation. Without activation-activation products, every transform-wise compilation adds at least $N^2$ scalar nonlinear evaluations per head for dense scores. Keeping that one operation type removes this cost; its elementwise form, present on every surveyed NPU, suffices with the sigmoid and inverse square root. For top-$k$ attention with exchangeable tail scores, we prove that exact or conditional-mean tail mass gives an unbiased, minimum-mean-square-error estimate

translated_title: 作为通用深度神经网络的Transformer：精确编译、移除激活-激活乘积的代价与多智能体注意力聚类
translated_abstract: Transformer通常被作为一种特殊的模型类别来部署。神经处理单元（NPU）为注意力和归一化添加了专用算子，量化也依赖于针对Transformer的特定算法。我们证明这种计算本身并不需要如此特殊化。每个包含注意力、LayerNorm和GELU MLP的Transformer块都可以被精确编译成一个通用深度神经网络，该网络仅由固定的仿射映射、路由，以及平方、sigmoid和逆平方根运算，再加上GELU或其sigmoid近似构成。在缺少激活-激活乘积运算的情况下，逐变换的编译对于稠密得分而言，每个注意力头至少需要额外增加N²次标量非线性求值。而保留这一种运算类型即可消除这一代价；其逐元素形式已存在于所有被调研的NPU上，配合sigmoid和逆平方根即已足够。对于具有可交换尾部得分的top-k注意力，我们证明了精确尾部质量或条件均值尾部质量能够给出无偏且均方误差最小的估计。
tldr: 本文证明每个Transformer块都能被精确编译成仅由仿射映射、路由和少数基本非线性运算构成的通用深度神经网络，并量化了移除激活-激活乘积运算所需付出的至少N²次额外标量非线性求值的代价，表明仅保留一种逐元素形式的该运算即可消除此开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that every Transformer block compiles exactly into a generic deep neural network built from affine maps, routing, and a few basic nonlinearities, and quantifies the cost of removing activation-activation products—showing that retaining just one elementwise form of this operation, already present on surveyed NPUs, eliminates the extra N² nonlinear evaluations per head.
